source: Derived from PP13 Qwen/Gemma/Kimi profiles after 2026-06-12 all-13 GPU stress passed; Kimi and DSV4 are intentionally absent.

resident_batch_token_budget.notes: Qwen keeps 262K model context and batch target 128; Gemma is raised to its config-advertised 262K context with batch target 128 after live PP12 telemetry showed batch-64 left GPUs far below saturation. Live launch must prove actual KV capacity before production promotion.

gpu_budget.stress_result: 13-node stress reached 96 pct GPU util on every node for 180s, peak raw GPU draw 1191.33 W, hottest node 87 C.

coordinator.notes: Post-92x DSAPI telemetry showed Qwen128+Gemma64 kept average GPU utilization near 15 pct while both queues were full. This throughput candidate raises Gemma to 128 and the global resident window to 256 while keeping combined GPU memory utilization below the 0.85 topology hard cap.

promotion_gates: Launch Qwen PP12 and Gemma PP12 from pulled main only.
Qwen and Gemma COMPSEC17 pass with >=2048 output token budget.
Run queue saturation at batch 128 for Qwen and 128 for Gemma while watching memory and power.
